issues.hardcodedColor: hand-written color `{color}`. Use a color role (CSS variable).
issues.cssImport: `@import` not allowed: everything must be inside the package.
issues.cssFontFace: `@font-face` not allowed: declare fonts in template.json.
issues.externalReference: external reference `{ref}`: use a file from `assets/`.
issues.slotMissingInHtml: slot "{name}" is in template.json but not in the HTML.
issues.listSlotTag: list slot "{name}" must be a `'<ul>'` or `'<ol>'` with a sample `'<li>'`.
issues.slotMissingInManifest: slot "{name}" is in the HTML but not in template.json.
issues.pathNotAllowed: path not allowed in the package.
issues.unboundVariable: variable `{name}` is not bound to a color or font role.
issues.notAFont: the file is not a WOFF2, WOFF, TTF or OTF font.
issues.fontNotShipped: the template uses "{name}" but the font is not in `fonts/`.
